# Import Data

## RTS

```{r}
rts_pt <- st_read("./01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_pt.geojson")
```

## Domain

```{r}
domain <- st_read("./01_processed_data/domain_south_clean.geojson")
```

## Environmental Predictors

```{r}
env_pred <- rast(
  "./01_processed_data/env_pred_rescale_6931.tif"
)

env_pred <- env_pred |>
  select(-names(env_pred)[which(str_detect(names(env_pred), "b1"))]) |>
  select(-names(env_pred)[which(str_detect(names(env_pred), "suitable"))]) |>
  select(-"hillslope_thermokarst")
```

## NaturalEarth

```{r}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  select(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
```

```{r}
crop_poly <- tibble(
  geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(0, 90)), crs = 'EPSG:4326')
) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt)) %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 5250000) %>%
  smoothr::densify(n = 3) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:4326')

crop_bbox <- crop_poly |>
  st_transform(6931) |>
  st_bbox()

long_lines <- seq(-180, 180, by = 60) %>%
  map(
    ~ long_lines_from_coords(.x, lat_min = st_bbox(crop_poly)[2], lat_max = 90)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows()

lat_lines <- seq(50, 90, by = 10) %>%
  map(~ lat_lines_from_coords(.x, lon_min = -180, lon_max = 180)) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
russia <- world |>
  filter(name == "Russia") |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(id = 1:n())

# West Wrangell Island is 29, East Wrangell Island is 31
russia$geometry[29] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[29], dist = 0.11)
russia$geometry[31] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[31], dist = 0.11)

russia <- russia |>
  select(-id)

russia <- russia |>
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(russia),
    .by = c(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
  )

world <- world |>
  filter(name != "Russia") |>
  rbind(russia)


world_north <- world %>%
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_intersection(crop_poly) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt))
```

(rts_pt_pattern <- c(

  as.ppp())

## Nearest Neighbor Distances

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = rts_pt,
  aes(x = nn_dist_km)
) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count) / sum(after_stat(count)))) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Nearest Neighbor Distance (km)",
    transform = "log10"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Percent",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
    labels = scales::percent
  )
```


# RTS Regions
This section creates RTS regions (spatially contiguous hotspot and coldspot regions) using the SKATER (Spatial 'K'luster Analysis by Tree Edge Removal) algorithm. Since RTS count is the attribute of interest for this clustering, I have first gridded the entire region and extracted RTS counts.

## Gridded Variables

### RTS Counts

```{r}
rts_grid <- rts_grid |>
  st_join(rts_pt) |>
  summarise(
    rts_count = n(),
    .by = geometry
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rts_count_log10 = log10(rts_count),
    .after = rts_count
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  rts_grid |>
    filter(rts_count > 1),
  aes(x = rts_count)
) +
  geom_histogram()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_north) +
  geom_sf(
    data = rts_grid,
    aes(color = rts_count, fill = rts_count)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(
    name = "RTS Count",
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis(
    name = "RTS Count",
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = crop_poly,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()
```

## SKATER

```{r}
rts_regions <- skater(
  rts_grid %>%
    select(rts_count_log10, glacial_extent_lgm, ecoregions),
  # attrs = c("rts_count_log10"),
  weights = "rook",
  n_regions = 14,
  bridge_islands = TRUE,
  seed = 42
) %>%
  summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), .by = .region) %>%
  mutate(centroid = st_centroid(geometry)) %>%
  bind_cols(
    .$centroid %>%
      st_transform(4326) %>%
      st_coordinates
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_north) +
  geom_sf(
    data = rts_regions,
    aes(color = .region, fill = .region)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = crop_poly,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()
```

# Regional Characteristics

## Size and Shape by Region
Options for measuring shape:
Polsby-Popper (area compared to circle with same perimeter; just need area and perimeter)
Reock (area compared to smallest square containing the shape; need full geometry)
Convex Hull (area compared to area of convex hull of shape; need full geometry)
CIRCLE (area compared to area of smallest circumscribing circle; need full geometry)

I will start with Polsby-Popper as I have used previously due to it's simplicity.
```{r}
rts_pt <- rts_pt |>
  st_join(rts_regions |> select(.region, region_lon = X, region_lat = Y)) |>
  mutate(
    pp = (4 * pi * area_m2) / perimeter_m^2
  )

rts_regions <- rts_regions |>
  full_join(
    rts_pt |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      summarise(
        mean_pp = mean(pp),
        mean_area_m2 = mean(area_m2),
        .by = .region
      ),
    by = ".region"
  )
```

Size by Region

```{r}
ggplot(rts_pt, aes(x = .region, y = area_m2)) +
  geom_violin() +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Region") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression("Area (m"^2 * ")"))

ggplot(
  rts_pt,
  aes(x = area_m2, y = round(region_lat, 2), group = round(region_lat, 2))
) +
  geom_violin() +
  scale_x_continuous(name = expression("Area (m"^2 * ")")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Region Latitude (Centroid)")
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_north) +
  geom_sf(
    data = rts_regions,
    aes(color = mean_area_m2, fill = mean_area_m2)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(name = expression("Area (m"^2 * ")")) +
  scale_fill_viridis(name = expression("Area (m"^2 * ")")) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = crop_poly,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()
```
